topic: Violence against other people can be justified in some cases

Violence against other people can be justified in some cases. If someone is going to inflict violence upon you, you are allowed to defend yourself. If someone is trying to harm someone close to you like a family member, it is your right to put a stop to it even if violence is necessary.
